sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2020. The East Kainji languages of Central Nigeria. Afrika und Übersee 93: 45-67. doi:10.15460/auue.2020.93.1.210 (and the 2004 ms. version 'The status of the East Kainji languages of Central Nigeria: recent research').
